claims.assertion: Yazhi says solar radiation carries galactic frequencies that may support consciousness shifts and restore human DNA to an alleged 12-strand pattern.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She frames this as a frequency-based interpretation, not accepted terrestrial science.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says the Sun is naturally white and that atmospheric conditions affect its apparent color and intensity.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She rejects claims that the Sun itself has changed.

review_flags: The dialogue includes unsupported claims about solar effects, DNA activation, and chemtrails.
coverage_gaps: Other sections discuss astral interpretations of gravity and cosmic waves.
